description: Meta-issue skip, qualified-string form (main#1053): wave_{M}_meta_issue is "noorinalabs-main#821" instead of the bare-int 821. The naive str(meta) == issue_number comparison would never match this shape (str("noorinalabs-main#821") == "821" is False); the fix extracts the trailing digit run from meta before comparing, so the skip still fires.
